description: For drywall repair, this inspection checklist records cutout boundary, backing, board type, treatment, drying intervals, dust control, texture match, and painting handoff. title: Drywall Repair Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during drywall damage repair and finish restoration when the drywall repair record must identify room, surface, substrate, damage dimensions, texture, finish, utilities, moisture source, and occupancy constraints. Complete the applicable handoff for dryness and finish verification, cleaned area, paint responsibility, customer acceptance, and recurrence note.
